en.title: The Tuner of the Mirror World and the Airship Dissolving in Sand
en.premise: As the 'Tuner' of this mansion, my duty is to repair broken clocks and polish clouded mirrors. But one day, my reflection smiles at a different time than I do, and I discover an impossible desert oasis stretching beyond the door. When an airship descends, crashing through the roof, the beautiful logic of the world I have protected is rewritten into a cruel reality.

zh.title: 镜面世界的调律师与溶于沙尘的飞船
zh.premise: 作为这栋宅邸的“调律师”，我一直致力于修理失控的时钟，擦拭模糊的镜面。直到某天，镜中的“我”露出了与我不同步的微笑，我发现门后竟延伸着一片本不该存在的沙漠绿洲。当飞船穿透屋顶降临时，我一直守护着的这个世界那美丽的逻辑，将被改写为残酷的真相。
